paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.22% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.95%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.15%). Brent crude changed -1.89% to 107.78. Gold changed +0.53% to 4,203.2998. Bitcoin changed +1.36% to 82,490.0312. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.098%, a relative move of +0.18%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+4.59%) and BP (+3.65%) moved the most.
